csv_scope_of_work: Architectural/engineering (A/E) design and construction management firms with experience in: preparation of plans/specifications/estimates (PS&E) for installation of hybrid pedestrian HAWK signals; traffic management studies/analysis; easement acquisition; and, comprehensive construction management services.
